$comment: The practice (#255): one short chapter that teaches by doing, offered in the lobby while any seated hero is new. Not a campaign a party continues: the server plays it without an attempt, a hero claim, XP or items, and marks every seated hero `practiced` when it ends (handlers/practice.ts, docs/architecture.md §4.5 "The practice"). Its id is PRACTICE_CAMPAIGN_ID in packages/shared/src/practice.ts.
title: First Steps
blurb: A sunny practice meadow, a faun with a clipboard, and a wisp who loves tag. Learn how to play before the real adventure starts.
